## Flow control (10)

| CyberChef | Status | Forge | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Magic | not yet |  |  |
| Fork | redesigned | `step:fork` | A structural fork step (RECIPES section 3.2) holds its child steps; split and join are part of the step. |
| Subsection | redesigned | `step:subsection` | A structural step that runs its children on each regex match and leaves the rest of the data alone. |
| Merge | redesigned | `step:fork` | No separate step: a fork step joins its pieces when its children end. |
| Register | not yet |  |  |
| Label | redesigned | `step:repeat` | Loops are structural repeat steps (a count or until stable), not labels. |
| Jump | redesigned | `step:repeat` | Loops are structural repeat steps (a count or until stable), not jumps. |
| Conditional Jump | redesigned | `step:if` | Branching is a tree: an if step holds then and else steps, so there are no labels or jumps. |
| Return | not yet |  |  |
| Comment | redesigned | `step:comment` | A structural comment step with no effect on the data. |
